LESSON: WRITING 8.4.1 FUNCTIONAL WRITING

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 8
Topic 8.4: Writing 8.4.1 Functional Writing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 5

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 8.4.1 Functional Writing, part of Strand 8 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How can we ensure that we write effective simple reports, memos and emails?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. team up with others to search online and offline for features of simple reports, memos and emails. Learners with manipulation difficulties could use alternative functional parts of the body, use adapted digital devices, assistive technology or be assisted,

2. use a chart to display the features identified. Learners with manipulation difficulties could use alternative functional parts of the body or use assistive technology,

3. write a simple report based on the theme using the features identified and share it for peer review. Learners with manipulation difficulties could use adapted writing tools and materials,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. team up with others to search online and offline for features of simple reports, memos and emails. Learners with manipulation difficulties could use alternative functional parts of the body, use adapted digital devices, assistive technology or be assisted,
2. use a chart to display the features identified. Learners with manipulation difficulties could use alternative functional parts of the body or use assistive technology,
3. write a simple report based on the theme using the features identified and share it for peer review. Learners with manipulation difficulties could use adapted writing tools and materials,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 8.4.1 Functional Writing together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Learning to Learn as the learner will reflect on their own work as they send one another emails with attachments.

● Self-efficacy-Personal skills are enhanced as the learner will analyse their strengths and weakness as they write a

simple report based on the theme using the features identified.

129

Values:
● Unity is promoted as the learner cooperates with others to search online and offline for features of simple reports,

memos and emails.

● Love is strengthened as the learner respects others as they display the memo and conduct a gallery work.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Citizenship education: The learners portray integrity and principles of leadership as they team up with others to search

online and offline for features of simple reports, memos and emails.

Suggested Learning Resources: Locally available materials to make customised cultural objects, language Games,

digital resources, authentic texts, internet, dictionaries and thesauruses, adapted digital devices with filter keys/key

guards/larger mouse/head control input devices such as head wand. universal cuffs/wrist braces/arm braces, weighted

pencil/pen grips
